threat.title: Threat model
threat.subtitle: Attack techniques per crown jewel, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and scored by coverage
threat.verdict: Techniques: {declared} · testable {testable} · ready {ready} · no grant {blocked} · untestable {untestable}.
threat.ran.unmeasured: A run has not cited a technique yet, so "ran" is unmeasured — not zero.
threat.empty.title: No technique declared for this jewel
threat.empty.hint: Declare what an attacker would actually do to it: the technique, and why it applies.
threat.noJewels.title: No crown jewel designated
threat.noJewels.hint: A threat model is written for one service: designate it in Scoping → Crown jewels first.
threat.dialog.searchHint: ATT&CK id, technique name or tactic
threat.dialog.noResults: No technique matches. The catalogue carries the ones this platform can reason about.
threat.dialog.reasonHint: exposed admin panel, public upload, dependency of the build…
threat.profile.note: A profile is an org-scoped bundle of techniques: a cycle cites it instead of redefining it.
threat.profile.name: name
threat.profiles.empty.title: No attacker profile yet
threat.profiles.empty.hint: Name the adversary you are modelling: opportunistic external, supply chain, insider.
threat.note: Coverage is arithmetic over declared techniques, the capability that could test each one, and the grant that allows it. A technique nobody can test is counted, never scored as covered.
